reasoning: The evidence strongly supports a 25 bps rate cut in March 2026. A Reuters poll from Feb 16, 2026 shows over 60% of 63 economists (41) forecast a 25 bps cut to 3.50%. The Feb 5 meeting was closely split 5-4 to hold at 3.75%, with 4 members already voting for a cut. Multiple analysts (ING, Barclays) expect Governor Bailey to shift dovish given weakening employment, falling wage growth (from 6% to projected 3%), and inflation expected to drop to ~1.8% by April. The baseline forecast from multiple sources is two 25 bps cuts in March and June.
